text:
maria: Noticing tail increase on host-preproc p99 after recent kernel-picker v2 deploy. Affects short streaming (<128 tokens) over gRPC. Traces indicate more time in proto_unmarshal and increased writev fragmentation.

sam: Any quick repro & flame?

maria: Repro used: `wrk -c180 -d60 -s scripts/short-stream.lua`

Quick perf sample (top hot functions):
```
proto_unmarshal 34%
writev_coalesce 22%
kvcache_lookup 10%
batcher_emit 6%
other 28%
```

maria: Before rollout most short flows picked `a64-fastpath`; after picker change many short flows pick `unified-quant`.

raj: Confirmed on canary: avg_batch_size dropped from ~5 -> ~2.8, kv hit-rate for short flows 99% -> 87%. Also saw occasional 0.6-0.9ms GC pauses in preproc thread.

luis: Theory: kernel choice influences batching heuristic (seq histogram used by picker) so batching shrinks; smaller batches -> more syscalls and smaller writev operations -> writev_coalesce overhead rises and proto_unmarshal handles more frames/sec. Additionally, kernel-specific kv keys are fragmenting cache.

sam: Options: revert seq<256 -> unified-quant rule; make kvcache kernel-agnostic for short flows (stable prefix); increase gRPC write coalesce window; add proto_unmarshal fastpath for tiny frames.

raj: Did quick revert on 2 hosts: batch_size returned to ~5 and p99 dropped near baseline. So rollback seems effective as immediate mitigation.

luis: I'll prototype a branchless fastpath for proto_unmarshal when frame_size < 256B to avoid checksum & alloc work. Local microbench shows ~18% cycle improvement for tiny frames.

maria: We should also emit metrics: `batch_size_by_kernel`, `kvcache_hit_by_kernel`, and `proto_unmarshal_p50_p99_by_frame_size`.

sam: I'll open rollback PR to remove the seq<256 mapping and a low-risk change to bump gRPC coalesce from 2ms -> 4ms on host-preproc. If rollback holds, we ship luis's fastpath and a stable-prefix for kvcache.

deploy-bot: kernel-picker v2 rolled to prod at 6302222100 by infra-release. Rollback patch available.

maria: Action items: sam: rollback PR + coalesce bump; luis: proto_unmarshal fastpath + canary; raj: stable-prefix PR and KV key heatmap; sam: add the metrics. Run 1h wrk + pprof after each change. Tagging SRE for incident capture.

luis: Note: stable-prefix must be TTL-aware to avoid cache poisoning; will gate behind canary flag.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post wrk outputs and linking pprofs to the ticket once available. :thumbsup:
